QuestInfo.name: Spiegelmann's Number Cruncher!
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelmann's got some number game up his sleeve... Sounds fun!
QuestInfo.1: If the sum of the numbers from the mysterious box matches up with Spiegelmann's number, you win! If it doesn't match, you get nothing! Are you ready for the challenge?!\r\n\r\n#e#b(You'll lose 3 dice if you forfeit the quest.)#k#n
QuestInfo.2: Only the brave can take on Spiegelmann's number game! Give it another go!
